event.pumpkincarnival.carnival_awakens.s: The shadows gather under the full moon...
Right-click to attune and sense the Misty Grounds
Right-Click: Guide toward Misty Grounds / Plantation
Use on Lantern: Ward fog monsters (Shift: Grand Boon)
Shift+Use / Click Crow: Summon flock or royal forage
Held in Misty Grounds: Spares you once from death

actionbar.pumpkincarnival.ticket.lantern: Lantern Ward awakened — shadows revealed in the mist.

actionbar.pumpkincarnival.ticket.crow_si: Crows answer your call through the fog.
actionbar.pumpkincarnival.ticket.crow_di: The crow accepts the royal pass and returns with tribute.
